paper: Align, Don't Blend: Orthogonal Supervision Disentanglement As the Key to Generalizable AI-Generated Image Detection (Chen et al., ACM MM 2026, arXiv 2512.06746 v3)
training_set_in_paper: Not trained in SynthScope. The full method as released: the official VLM adapter (adb_vlm: Gaffeyzz/Align-Dont-Blend-VLM @ 49975ccd on Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct @ cc594898, greedy, bf16) OR the official pixel expert (the released DDA checkpoint DDA_ckpt.pth = dda.pth; the authors confirmed DDA is the expert, 2026-11-20), with the official rule of predict.py (GzZning/Align-Dont-Blend @ 5d83e40): fake if the VLM's parsed verdict is AI-generated or DDA P(fake) >= 0.5. Per image, the committed or new adb_vlm records are fused with dda records on the same files (repro/adb_full/fuse.py); every row is in repro/adb_full/paper_comparison.json and repro/adb_full/results/. Balanced accuracy, mean over the paper's subsets.

benchmarks.name: WildRF (Facebook, Reddit, Twitter test sets), full data, 2,503 images
benchmarks.metric: balanced accuracy per platform, and their mean

our_number.note: Full data, VLM bf16 greedy on RTX A5000 (the committed adb_vlm run) OR dda: 91.22 balanced acc (facebook 90.94 / reddit 89.33 / twitter 93.4), AUROC 99.22 (-1.68 vs the paper; every platform below it: Facebook -1.26, Reddit -1.57, Twitter -2.10, so below, as VINA's WildRF row). VLM alone 93.98, DDA alone 90.2. Float32 + eager VLM (the README command) on an RTX A6000 (precision and GPU both change): 91.34 (AUROC 99.25).

benchmarks.name: BFree-Online, all held images (269 real + 538 fake still online of the 1,111 listed)

our_number.note: 807 of the paper's 1,111 images (the rest are offline): 96.93 balanced acc, AUROC 99.11 (-0.57); VLM alone 87.08, DDA alone 94.98; VLM bf16 on RTX A5000. The vlm_bench subset (269 + 500): 97.08. Not the paper's full set, so reference.

benchmarks.name: AIGI-Bench CommunityAI + SocialRF (SocialRF full; CommunityAI the first 1,500 real + 1,500 fake of 12,000)
benchmarks.metric: balanced accuracy per subset, and their mean

our_number.note: 9,000 images, VLM bf16 on RTX A5000: 87.52 balanced acc (CommunityAI 91.2 / SocialRF 83.83), AUROC 97.35 (-1.28); VLM alone 89.65, DDA alone 82.41. One VLM answer (a SocialRF fake) is unparsed (the official script would stop on it); DDA calls it fake, so it counts as fake. CommunityAI is a quarter of its images, so reference. The 20 + 20 vlm_bench slices: 81.25.

benchmarks.name: GenImage (8 generators), the first 625 real + 625 fake per generator of GenImage val (10,000), fakes JPEG q96

paper_number.note: appendix Table 6; fakes JPEG-compressed 'following BFree', no quality given (q96 is our choice)

our_number.note: 10,000 images (a tenth of GenImage val), VLM bf16 on RTX A5000: 86.70 balanced acc [bootstrap 95% CI 86.10, 87.29], AUROC 92.86 (-5.00 vs the paper); VLM alone 61.05, DDA alone 89.35 (DDA on the full data: 89.37). Four generators more than 2 points below the paper's columns (BigGAN, VQDM, Wukong, GLIDE), so reference. The earlier 63-per-class subset (1,008, a prefix): 85.12.
